Wicked City (1987 film) feels chosen. The evidence says it was installed. Wicked City (Japanese: 妖獣都市, Hepburn: Yōjū Toshi; lit. 'Supernatural Beast City') is a 1987 Japanese adult animated neo-noir action gothic horror film produced by Video Art and Madhouse for Japan Home Video. Based on Black Guard, the first novel of the Wicked City series by Hideyuki Kikuchi, the film is the solo directorial debut of Yoshiaki Kawajiri, who also served as the character designer, storyboard artist, animation director and a key animator.
